mapper.update: UPDATE biz_spas_reservation_stock as stock SET status = 0, update_time = NOW(), update_by = 'system' WHERE reservation_time <= ( select str_to_date(CONCAT(CURRENT_DATE(), ' ', cut_off_time),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') from biz_spas_projects as project where project.project_id = stock.project_id) AND status = 1
